messages:
nina (docs): Heads-up: we're scheduling a short deprecation for /v1/invoke -> /v2. Timeline: 10d soft warnings, then 5d enforcement. Need docs, SDK, and examples aligned. I'll push a banner PR this afternoon.

sam (sdk): Acknowledged. SDK surface change: 'model' renamed to 'model_id'; embedding vector lengths changed for some models; streaming framing updated. We'll add a compat shim and a migration example in JS/Python.

omar (devex): Owners: @sam (sdk), @nina (docs), @mikel (oncall). I'll compile common user FAQs and a short troubleshooting section for the migration doc. Can someone search for any hardcoded "/v1/invoke" snippets?

sam (sdk): Quick grep: `rg \"/v1/invoke\" docs/ examples/ -n`
I'll add a README snippet: `client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-rw') })` and a test ensuring both model and model_id accepted.

mikel (eng-oncall): I'll prepare a limited canary and a rollback command. Put this in ops notes:
```
# rollback to v1 proxy
./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration"
```
Will watch error delta; if >0.5% trigger rollback.

nina (docs): Docs checklist: 1) banner + dates; 2) quick migration guide (what breaks + one-line fixes); 3) update js/py/curl snippets; 4) redirect map; 5) smoke tests link. I'll take 1 & 2.

omar (devex): Smoke curl for CI:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model_id":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}'
```
Expect 200 and token_count. I'll add to /scripts/smoke/migrate_check.sh.

lint-bot: Reminder: PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint. Fix broken links or CI will fail.

sam (sdk): Action items: add compat tests + ops note. nina -> docs banner + migration quickstart. omar -> smoke script + FAQ. mikel -> rollback playbook and run canary. Target: soft-deprec announcement tomorrow EOD. :rocket:
